# Cencora

> > Cencora is a global healthcare company transforming pharmaceutical distribution, patient access, and clinical support through integrated supply chain solutions and specialty services.

Cencora operates across the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific, providing comprehensive pharmaceutical distribution, logistics, pharmacy management, and commercialization support services to healthcare providers, pharmacies, and biopharma companies. The company specializes in specialty therapies, biosimilars, cell and gene therapy, and oncology solutions.

## Key Topics

- Pharmaceutical Distribution
- Supply Chain Management
- Pharmacy Solutions
- Market Access
- Patient Access & Adherence
- Logistics & Warehousing
- Specialty Therapies
- Biosimilars
- Cell & Gene Therapy
- Oncology
- Regulatory Affairs
- Product Commercialization
- Health Systems Solutions
- Global Operations
- Clinical Trial Support

## Core Capabilities

- [Logistics & Warehousing Solutions](https://www.cencora.com/our-capabilities/logistics-and-warehousing): Temperature-controlled logistics and 3PL warehousing for pharmaceutical supply chains
- [Wholesale and Specialty Distribution](https://www.cencora.com/our-capabilities/wholesale-and-specialty-distribution): Wholesale and specialty pharmaceutical distribution including vaccine programs
- [Commercialization Support](https://www.cencora.com/our-capabilities/commercialization-support): Pharma launch and market access services for specialty therapies and biosimilars
- [Drug Research & Clinical Development Support](https://www.cencora.com/our-capabilities/drug-research-and-clinical-development-support): Global clinical trial and drug development support services for biopharma
- [Patient Access and Adherence Support](https://www.cencora.com/our-capabilities/patient-access-and-adherence-support): Patient access and adherence solutions through Alliance Healthcare and Alphega

## Healthcare Provider Solutions

- [Hospital & Health System Solutions](https://www.cencora.com/our-capabilities/hospital-and-health-system-solutions): Hospital and health system supply chain optimization and pharmacy services
- [Pharmacy Solutions](https://www.cencora.com/our-capabilities/pharmacy-solutions): Pharmacy management and logistics solutions via Accelerate Pharmacy platform
- [Practice & Clinic Solutions](https://www.cencora.com/our-capabilities/practice-and-clinic-solutions): Specialty practice and clinic solutions with MIPS and EHR integration

## Specialty & Therapeutic Solutions

- [Oncology Therapy Solutions](https://www.cencora.com/specialties/oncology): Oncology therapy commercialization and market access services
- [Biosimilars: Access & Distribution](https://www.cencora.com/specialties/biosimilars): Biosimilar distribution expertise and market access solutions
- [Cell and Gene Therapy](https://www.cencora.com/specialties/cell-and-gene-therapy): Advanced cell and gene therapy commercialization and logistics services
- [Global Generic Products & Distribution](https://www.cencora.com/specialties/global-generic-products): Global generic product distribution via PRxO and SmartSource programs

## Product Innovation & Solutions

- [Product and Solution Innovation](https://www.cencora.com/solutions/product-and-solution-innovation): Innovative healthcare solutions including virtual warehousing and specialty services
- [Solutions Finder Portal](https://www.cencora.com/solutions): Comprehensive business offerings and solutions browsing portal

## Global Operations

- [Global Reach](https://www.cencora.com/global-reach): Global operations across Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific regions
- [North and South America Markets](https://www.cencora.com/global-reach/north-and-south-america): Healthcare solutions across North and South American markets

## Optional

- [OTC & Consumer Healthcare Products](https://www.cencora.com/specialties/otc-and-consumer-healthcare-products): OTC and consumer healthcare distribution through Good Neighbor Pharmacy network
- [Medical Brand & Specialty Products](https://www.cencora.com/specialties/brand-and-specialty-products): Brand and specialty product distribution and commercialization solutions
- [Mature Product Outsourcing](https://www.cencora.com/specialties/mature-product-outsourcing): Strategic outsourcing services for mature pharmaceutical product portfolios
